newsitem.title: USA: Muni bond sales total $3 bln for next week.
newsitem.headline: Muni bond sales total $3 bln for next week.

text.p: Municipal bond sales for next week were expected to total $3 billion in 103 sales, according to Reuters Municipal Bond Information Group.
Negotiated offerings total $2.033 billion in 51 sales, with a $340 million California Natural Resources offering through PaineWebber Inc., topping the list.
On the competitive side, 52 sales totaling $966 million are scheduled. A 250 million Maryland offering on Wednesday is the largest.
An additional three sales totaling $357 million are on the possible calender, meaning underwriters have said they may price the issues next week depending on market conditions.
